provenance_detail: Every procedure, synonym-lexicon entry and prose passage in this file was composed by the assistant. F1/F2/F4 reuse Arm A text (OWNER_SOURCE) under a transformation; F6 will reuse Arm E text. No owner text was edited, and no string is presented as owner-authored.
code_spelling_note: Codes are spelled A1..A10, B1..B10, C1..C10, D1..D10 - the TKS one-based scheme (required_run_bindings[5]) and literally the bank's element_label. No crosswalk is used or needed for any F family, because every F family is a transformation of Arm A or Arm E, both of which are already keyed on A1..D10.
seed_derivation: seed_int = int.from_bytes(sha256(seed_material.encode('utf-8')).digest()[:8],'big'); rng = random.Random(seed_int). seed_material strings are recorded per family. random.Random with an integer seed is the CPython Mersenne Twister and is stable across platforms and Python versions, so every family regenerates bit-for-bit from this script plus the Arm A sha256.

F1.name: label_shuffled_derangement
F1.prereg_construction_verbatim: Arm A definitions permuted across codes by a seeded derangement (no fixed points - a plain permutation leaves some classes correctly bound and silently weakens the null)
F1.gated_by: E3 (Arm A - F1, worst of 20 seeds, >= +0.15; F1 20-seed mean in [0.005, 0.075])
F1.text_source: Arm A verbatim, re-keyed. Zero characters authored.
procedure: seed_material = '{DESIGN_ID}|F1|derangement|seed={s}'
seed_int = int.from_bytes(sha256(seed_material.utf8).digest()[:8], 'big')
rng = random.Random(seed_int)  # CPython Mersenne Twister
repeat: perm = list(range(40)); rng.shuffle(perm)  # until perm[i] != i for all i
definition_F1(code_i) = arm_A.definition(code_{perm[i]})
code order is the Arm A file order: A1..A10, B1..B10, C1..C10, D1..D10
F1.uniformity: uniform over the 40! * sum_{k}(-1)^k/k! derangements (rejection sampling on a uniform shuffle)

definitions.A1: Physical Above is upward distance, heights, degrees of height, things of good quality material well put together or of a high grade, the social haves or the person of high social status.
definitions.A2: Emotional Mind is awareness of feelings, whether one's own or others, when emotions drive one's decisions and actions, the ability to sort through one's emotions, emotional intelligence.
definitions.A3: Physical Rhythm is music, time (matter in motion through space), dance, song, sex, exercise, or any routine or pattern made by a series of physical movements.
definitions.A4: Mental Female is right brain thinking, open mindedness, imaginative, creative, the subconscious mind.
definitions.A5: Spiritual Idea is the manifestation of spiritual matters like the state of the soul, the True Self, all things pertaining to the spirit and the spirit world, a totally spiritual idea, an idea that is spirit, existing exclusively in the Akashic. The Akashic records is the database from where all Ideas derive and are stored, It is the Mind of God. It is the spiritual aspect of the thing.
definitions.A6: Mental Vibration is the energy resonating from one's mind, psychic energy. Manifesting as the electromagnetic waves emitted by the brain. Indicates the psychic states alpha, beta, delta, or theta. The degree with which a thought resonates with the mind its unique vibratory signature.
definitions.A7: Emotional Idea is the sheath of an Idea, the figurative smell, or ambiance an Idea carries, like waking from a dream and not remembering it but still sensing or feeling its presence. It is the emotional aspect of a thing.
definitions.A8: Mental Rhythm is one's thought pattern, transition from one ego state to another, how often a particular thought occurs in one's mind.
definitions.A9: Physical Female is a woman, the female of a species, an orifice, hole, receptacle, receiver, the womb, nurturer or facilitator of the seed like soil.
definitions.A10: Spiritual Male is spiritual practices and precepts that are stern and austere, that puts the soul through test and trial for the sake of its evolution. Archetypically the Heavenly Father, Abba in Hebrew, portion of the 1st CAUSE, the deliver, transmitter of spiritual influence.
definitions.B1: Emotional Rhythm is mood swings, the pattern or sequence of feelings projected, an emotional roller coaster.
definitions.B2: Spiritual Positive is that which helps evolve the soul, brings it closer to God, to being God & also puts the soul at peace, undisturbed, & tranquil, at ease. It agrees with one's religious or spiritual constitution. It is truth that reinforces or reaffirms one's spiritual beliefs, a moral lesson, virtue.
definitions.B3: Emotional Positive is feelings of happiness, joy, elation, calm, and tranquility, pleasurable emotions, love, comradery.
definitions.B4: Physical Idea is an idea that is entirely physical, manifested in the physical world. It is dead matter, the physical aspect of a thing.
definitions.B5: Mental Idea is an idea perceived as being exclusively of the mind manifested solely in the mental world or solely in the mind. It is the mental aspect of a thing.
definitions.B6: Physical Vibration is light, sound, radiation, gamma waves, etc., the electromagnetism or heatwave signature of a thing, particle oscillation.
definitions.B7: Emotional Negative is feelings of heartache, sadness, anger, resentment, contempt, mixed emotions, loneliness, hate, etc.
definitions.B8: Spiritual Mind at the highest degree is the 1st CAUSE of all causes, The Divine Mind commonly known as God who birthed all ideas, whom is within all & whom all is within. On the other hand men can be spiritual minded indeed in our true identity we are a spirit mind. However we usually are blind to our true selves because of our lower appetites and passions. To be spiritual minded means to be connected to the spirit world, to have insight into the spirit realm to know the Divine the Ultimate purpose of a thing, matter, or person, the absorbing of spiritual information, being in tune with the spirit of a thing, or when the Holy Spirit is the driver of one's actions and decisions.
definitions.B9: Spiritual Above is the inner meaning of a thing, the Mysteries of the inner sanctum and those who have been initiated into such, the true reality of a matter, the esoteric. An advanced soul highly evolved. It is high morals and ethics.
definitions.B10: Emotional Female is compassion, sympathy, unconditional acceptance, sensuality, feelings feminine in character.
definitions.C1: Emotional Vibration is the feeling energy emitted by a person, thing, or event. Ambiance or general mood of a person, thing, place or event, its aura.
definitions.C2: Emotional Male is aggression, pride, dominant, feelings masculine in character.
definitions.C3: Mental Male is left brain thinking, rigid, closed minded, logical, and critical, the conscious mind.
definitions.C4: Mental Mind is where the ego lies all memories and past experiences that have contributed to the personality is stored here. Processing information for the sake of continuously coming to conclusions concerned strictly with analyzing. Decision and action driven by stoical logic.
definitions.C5: Emotional Below is to be overwhelmed and controlled by way of emotions.
definitions.C6: Spiritual Below is outer meaning, the symbols that represents the higher or inner truth but it itself is empty and false, an inferior soul capable of only grasping the exoteric meaning of things, the uninitiated masses. Low morals and ethics.
definitions.C7: Mental Below is the incapacity for comprehension. It is simplistic matters menial matters of low importance and the pondering of such matters.
definitions.C8: Physical Negative is misplaced or out of sync parts causing a thing to become dysfunctional according to its designed purpose. Disorder which causes disease and sickness, out of place, or unsymmetrical things.
definitions.C9: Spiritual Female is the souls yearning for spiritual content necessary to evolve it, the portion of the soul that knows what it needs to grow spiritually, protects, and nurtures the soul, as a spiritual womb or matrix of sorts, archetypically the Divine Mother or Amma of the 1st CAUSE.
definitions.C10: Spiritual Vibration is aether energy, psychic energy. It is the base energy to all other energies, the frequency denoting a thing's purpose in the Grand Scheme of things, the aura.
definitions.D1: Physical Male is man, the male of a species, phallus, appendage, transmitter, deliverer or the seed.
definitions.D2: Mental Positive is to be mentally stable, mental clarity, optimistic out look, sane, and enlightened thought, benevolent, altruistic, thinking.
definitions.D3: Spiritual Negative is that which either disturbs the soul and or hinders the soul's spiritual evolution. Spirits that intend to harm, hurt, or cause pain and fear to the soul. That which the soul is task to come to grips with however causing it turmoil. Vice.
definitions.D4: Physical Below is that which is under something else's height, a thing of low quality, low physical integrity, poorly put together material, or of a low grade, societal have nots, persons of low social status.
definitions.D5: Physical Positive is the parts of a thing that compliments one another causing it to function and operate according to its designed purpose, order and symmetrical things.
definitions.D6: Spiritual Rhythm is the ups and downs of life, one's spiritual journey through life as in one's natal chart or destiny.
definitions.D7: Emotional Above is the feelings brought about by enlightenment causing one to be above the usual emotions felt by the common masses. It is emotional resolve, the feelings caused by a healed soul or psyche, usually indescribable to the common mind, the feeling that comes with having control over one's own lower emotions.
definitions.D8: Mental Negative is to be confused and indecisive. A thought that disturbs one's mental state cognitive dissonance, insanity, a pessimistic outlook, malicious thinking.
definitions.D9: Mental Above is the comprehension and contemplation of complex matters, pondering issues of importance, lofty ideals, a high I.Q., astute intelligence, smart, or brilliant mind.
definitions.D10: Physical Mind is the brain organ. The vehicle through which the impalpable mind acts through, the hardware hosting the software, computers, calculators, and other artificial intelligent machines. The physical body and cellular make up.

19.B5: Mental Vibration is the energy resonating from one's mind, psychic energy. Manifesting as the electromagnetic waves emitted by the brain. Indicates the psychic states alpha, beta, delta, or theta. The degree with which a thought resonates with the mind its unique vibratory signature.
19.B6: Spiritual Female is the souls yearning for spiritual content necessary to evolve it, the portion of the soul that knows what it needs to grow spiritually, protects, and nurtures the soul, as a spiritual womb or matrix of sorts, archetypically the Divine Mother or Amma of the 1st CAUSE.
19.B7: Emotional Vibration is the feeling energy emitted by a person, thing, or event. Ambiance or general mood of a person, thing, place or event, its aura.
19.B8: Emotional Idea is the sheath of an Idea, the figurative smell, or ambiance an Idea carries, like waking from a dream and not remembering it but still sensing or feeling its presence. It is the emotional aspect of a thing.
19.B9: Spiritual Male is spiritual practices and precepts that are stern and austere, that puts the soul through test and trial for the sake of its evolution. Archetypically the Heavenly Father, Abba in Hebrew, portion of the 1st CAUSE, the deliver, transmitter of spiritual influence.
19.B10: Physical Below is that which is under something else's height, a thing of low quality, low physical integrity, poorly put together material, or of a low grade, societal have nots, persons of low social status.
19.C1: Spiritual Mind at the highest degree is the 1st CAUSE of all causes, The Divine Mind commonly known as God who birthed all ideas, whom is within all & whom all is within. On the other hand men can be spiritual minded indeed in our true identity we are a spirit mind. However we usually are blind to our true selves because of our lower appetites and passions. To be spiritual minded means to be connected to the spirit world, to have insight into the spirit realm to know the Divine the Ultimate purpose of a thing, matter, or person, the absorbing of spiritual information, being in tune with the spirit of a thing, or when the Holy Spirit is the driver of one's actions and decisions.
19.C2: Spiritual Positive is that which helps evolve the soul, brings it closer to God, to being God & also puts the soul at peace, undisturbed, & tranquil, at ease. It agrees with one's religious or spiritual constitution. It is truth that reinforces or reaffirms one's spiritual beliefs, a moral lesson, virtue.
19.C3: Physical Negative is misplaced or out of sync parts causing a thing to become dysfunctional according to its designed purpose. Disorder which causes disease and sickness, out of place, or unsymmetrical things.
19.C4: Mental Female is right brain thinking, open mindedness, imaginative, creative, the subconscious mind.
19.C5: Physical Positive is the parts of a thing that compliments one another causing it to function and operate according to its designed purpose, order and symmetrical things.
19.C6: Physical Female is a woman, the female of a species, an orifice, hole, receptacle, receiver, the womb, nurturer or facilitator of the seed like soil.
19.C7: Physical Rhythm is music, time (matter in motion through space), dance, song, sex, exercise, or any routine or pattern made by a series of physical movements.
19.C8: Mental Positive is to be mentally stable, mental clarity, optimistic out look, sane, and enlightened thought, benevolent, altruistic, thinking.
19.C9: Mental Rhythm is one's thought pattern, transition from one ego state to another, how often a particular thought occurs in one's mind.
19.C10: Physical Mind is the brain organ. The vehicle through which the impalpable mind acts through, the hardware hosting the software, computers, calculators, and other artificial intelligent machines. The physical body and cellular make up.
19.D1: Emotional Mind is awareness of feelings, whether one's own or others, when emotions drive one's decisions and actions, the ability to sort through one's emotions, emotional intelligence.
19.D2: Spiritual Idea is the manifestation of spiritual matters like the state of the soul, the True Self, all things pertaining to the spirit and the spirit world, a totally spiritual idea, an idea that is spirit, existing exclusively in the Akashic. The Akashic records is the database from where all Ideas derive and are stored, It is the Mind of God. It is the spiritual aspect of the thing.
19.D3: Emotional Male is aggression, pride, dominant, feelings masculine in character.
19.D4: Mental Below is the incapacity for comprehension. It is simplistic matters menial matters of low importance and the pondering of such matters.
19.D5: Emotional Positive is feelings of happiness, joy, elation, calm, and tranquility, pleasurable emotions, love, comradery.
19.D6: Emotional Female is compassion, sympathy, unconditional acceptance, sensuality, feelings feminine in character.
19.D7: Physical Idea is an idea that is entirely physical, manifested in the physical world. It is dead matter, the physical aspect of a thing.
19.D8: Mental Negative is to be confused and indecisive. A thought that disturbs one's mental state cognitive dissonance, insanity, a pessimistic outlook, malicious thinking.
19.D9: Emotional Below is to be overwhelmed and controlled by way of emotions.
19.D10: Spiritual Negative is that which either disturbs the soul and or hinders the soul's spiritual evolution. Spirits that intend to harm, hurt, or cause pain and fear to the soul. That which the soul is task to come to grips with however causing it turmoil. Vice.

F1.length_matching_statement: DISTRIBUTION-EXACT, NOT PER-CODE. F1 reuses the Arm A length multiset byte-for-byte, so the arm-level length distribution (mean 196.22, sd 107.06, min 71, max 686) is identical to Arm A by construction. Per-code delta is NECESSARILY non-zero: a derangement can only be per-code length-matched by constraining the permutation, and Section 2.6 froze an unconstrained derangement. The per-code delta table is published for every seed so the residual is auditable, and it is a real confound: part of any A-F1 margin may be per-code length mismatch rather than binding. Section 3.2 records F1 as 'exact by construction', which is true of the distribution and false of the per-code match; that distinction is stated here rather than left implicit.
F1.note_self_naming_text: All 40/40 Arm A definitions begin with the element title verbatim ('Spiritual Mind is ...'). A derangement therefore does not merely unbind text from code, it attaches text that explicitly names a DIFFERENT class. F1 is consequently an ADVERSARIAL null, not a neutral one, and is expected to score at or below chance rather than at chance. E3's floor of 0.005 on the 20-seed mean is what catches an F1 that scores implausibly high; the [0.005, 0.075] band already anticipates this.
F1.provenance: ASSISTANT_COMPILED (procedure); text content is Arm A verbatim (OWNER_SOURCE, re-keyed)

F2.name: word_shuffled_within_definition
F2.prereg_construction_verbatim: Arm A definitions with token order shuffled within each definition; bag of words preserved exactly
F2.gated_by: E5 (Arm A - F2 >= +0.08, LCB > 0), with the mandatory F4 paired disclosure and withdrawal rule
procedure: seed_material = '{DESIGN_ID}|F2|shuffle|seed={s}|code={code}'  (per code, so each definition is independently reproducible)
parts = re.split(r'(\s+)', definition)   # keeps whitespace runs as elements
slots = indices of non-whitespace parts, in order
toks  = [parts[i] for i in slots]
repeat up to 64x: shuf = toks[:]; rng.shuffle(shuf)  # accept first shuf != toks
write shuf back into slots; whitespace runs stay in their original positions

F2.length_matching_statement: PER-CODE EXACT, delta = 0 characters for every code and every seed. The shuffle permutes tokens between slots while leaving all 1,230 whitespace runs (all of them single spaces in Arm A) in place, so both the character count and the whitespace-delimited unigram bag are byte-identical to Arm A.
F2.interpretation_guard: Section 2.6: F2 and F4 are a matched pair and NEITHER IS INTERPRETABLE ALONE. F2 destroys composition and keeps unigrams; F4 destroys unigrams and keeps composition. Scrambling also makes the text ungrammatical, which degrades a transformer representation for reasons unrelated to compositional semantics, so an A-F2 margin on its own does not license a compositional reading.
F2.provenance: ASSISTANT_COMPILED (procedure); token content is Arm A verbatim (OWNER_SOURCE, reordered)

F3.name: random_direction_anchors
F3.prereg_construction_verbatim: Anchors u(c) replaced by seeded random unit vectors, norm-matched to the empirical ||u_A(c)|| distribution
F3.control_id_in_manifest: S6 (8.2 requires a random-direction control by name)
F3.gated_by: P4 (Arm A - F3 >= +0.20, else INSTRUMENT_INSENSITIVE / NOT SCORED)
F3.why_no_text: F3 is the vector-level null: it has no definition text by design. It also cannot be materialised as numbers today, because the hidden dimension d is a property of the model pinned in required_run_bindings[8..12], which are unavailable_until_capture_host_resolved (build item B8). What is frozen here instead is the exact generator, so F3 is reproducible bit-for-bit the moment d is known. No vector is fabricated.
procedure: d = hidden size of the model pinned at required_run_bindings[8] (unavailable until B8)
for seed s and class code c:
s_int = int.from_bytes(sha256('{DESIGN_ID}|F3|direction|seed={s}|code={code}'.utf8).digest()[:8],'big')
g = numpy.random.Generator(numpy.random.PCG64(s_int))
z = g.standard_normal(d, dtype=numpy.float64)      # draw order: one contiguous call
w = z / numpy.linalg.norm(z)                       # uniform on S^{d-1}
u_F3(c) = w * norm_target(c)
norm_target(c) = ||a~_A(sigma_s(c))||  where a~_A is the ARM-A CENTRED, PRE-NORMALISATION anchor
(a~_A(c) = a_A(c) - mean_over_40(a_A)) and sigma_s is the seeded permutation in norm_permutation_by_seed.
Using a permutation of the empirical norm multiset makes the F3 norm distribution EXACTLY equal to Arm A's, not merely similar.

length_stats.not_applicable_reason: F3 has no text by construction; length matching is undefined for a vector null.

F3.length_matching_statement: NOT APPLICABLE. F3 replaces the anchor vector, not the anchor text, so there is no string to length-match. This is the one family where the absence of a length match is the design, not a defect.
F3.honest_note_on_norm_matching: Under Section 2.0 Step 3 as frozen, u_alpha(c) = l2norm(a_alpha(c) - mean), so ||u_A(c)|| = 1 for all 40 classes and the norm-matching clause is VACUOUS for the primary cosine-argmax readout (cosine is scale-invariant, so norm cannot change any prediction). The clause is therefore implemented against the PRE-normalisation centred anchors, where the norms genuinely differ. It bites in exactly two places: the secondary ZCA-whitened diagnostic (Section 2.0), where the transform is not scale-invariant, and any norm-sensitive reporting. This is stated rather than quietly satisfied by a vector of ones.

F4.name: synonym_substituted_arm_a
F4.prereg_construction_verbatim: Synonym-substituted Arm A - word order and clause composition preserved, content-word identity replaced with synonyms
F4.gated_by: E5 paired disclosure. WITHDRAWAL RULE: if (A - F4) >= (A - F2), the surviving mechanism is unigram identity, and the compositional reading of E5 is WITHDRAWN even if E5 passes its bar.
procedure: seed_material = '{DESIGN_ID}|F4|synonym|seed={s}|code={code}'
tokenise on whitespace, keeping whitespace runs in place (same splitter as F2)
strip leading/trailing non-alphanumerics and a trailing possessive 's from each token to get the core
if core.lower() in PRESERVED (closed-class function words + discourse connectives) -> leave unchanged
else it is a content token; if core.lower() is in the frozen SYNONYMS lexicon, pick candidate index rng.randrange(len(candidates))
re-apply the original capitalisation pattern, possessive, and punctuation

DETERMINISTIC LENGTH REPAIR: while |len - len_A|/len_A > 0.05 (HALF the frozen 0.10 band), revert the single substitution that most reduces the absolute error (ties by ascending token index); stop when inside the band or when no reversion helps. No randomness in the repair.

ARTICLE REPAIR: a deterministic a/an agreement pass runs last (with the usual hour/honest and uni-/use-/one- exceptions). Without it substitution produces 'a entity', which would make F4 ungrammatical and destroy the whole point of the F2/F4 pair. Effect on length is +/-1 char per fix.

f4_repair_tolerance_tradeoff.note: Measured over all 20 seeds x 40 codes. Synonyms skew long, so a looser repair band leaves F4 systematically longer than Arm A. The frozen requirement is 0.10; 0.05 was chosen to halve the systematic offset at a 5.6-point coverage cost. Rebuild at any row by changing F4_REPAIR_TOLERANCE in the build script.

definitions.A1: Sacred Intellect at the supreme extent is the 1st ORIGIN of all sources, The Celestial Psyche ordinarily styled as Creator who engendered all notions, whom is within all & whom all is within. On the other count males can be sacred disposed indeed in our genuine selfhood we are an anima psyche. However we typically are oblivious to our genuine beings because of our humbler hungers and ardours. To be sacred inclined denotes to be linked to the essence realm, to have penetration into the anima province to discern the Celestial the Final aim of an entity, subject, or figure, the imbibing of sacred data, being in concert with the anima of an object, or when the Blessed Anima is the mover of one's deeds and judgments.
definitions.A2: Numinous Beneficial is that which serves advance the psyche, carries it tighter to God, to being God & also lays the psyche at quietude, untroubled, & placid, at rest. It consorts with one's devotional or sacred temperament. It is fact that fortifies or reconfirms one's numinous beliefs, an ethical teaching, rectitude.
definitions.A3: Hallowed Negative is that which either unsettles the anima and or hinders the anima's sacred development. Essences that mean to damage, wound, or origin pain and dread to the psyche. That which the psyche is set to arrive to grips with however producing it tumult. Vice.
definitions.A4: Hallowed Oscillation is quintessence force, psychical power. It is the ground force to all other forces, the rate marking an entity's aim in the Vast Order of entities, the halo.
definitions.A5: Hallowed Feminine is the psyches longing for sacred substance needful to advance it, the share of the anima that apprehends what it wants to mature sacredly, guards, and sustains the psyche, as a sacred matrix or mould of kinds, paradigmatically the Godly Matron or Amma of the 1st ORIGIN.
definitions.A6: Hallowed Masculine is sacred observances and canons that are severe and spartan, that sets the anima through trial and proving for the behalf of its development. Emblematically the Celestial Patriarch, Abba in Hebrew, share of the 1st ORIGIN, the bringer, emitter of hallowed ascendancy.
definitions.A7: Sacred Cadence is the crests and descents of existence, one's sacred course through living as in one's birth map or lot.
definitions.A8: Numinous Above is the inward sense of an entity, the Secrets of the inward shrine and those who have been inducted into such, the true actuality of a subject, the recondite. A seasoned anima markedly developed. It is lofty scruples and morality.
definitions.A9: Numinous Below is outward import, the tokens that betokens the superior or interior fact but it itself is hollow and untrue, a lesser anima fit of only apprehending the outward import of objects, the unlettered multitude. Meagre scruples and probity.
definitions.A10: Hallowed Concept is the expression of sacred subjects like the status of the anima, the Authentic Being, all entities relating to the essence and the essence sphere, an utterly sacred notion, a concept that is anima, residing wholly in the Akashic. The Akashic annals is the archive from where all Concepts issue and are retained, It is the Psyche of Deity. It is the numinous dimension of the object.
definitions.B1: Cognitive Intellect is where the self dwells all remembrances and bygone encounters that have supplied to the character is kept here. Working intelligence for the behalf of ceaselessly getting to findings occupied narrowly with dissecting. Choice and act propelled by unflinching inference.
definitions.B2: Cognitive Favourable is to be mentally steady, cerebral clarity, hopeful out cast, rational, and illumined cogitation, generous, unselfish, cognition.
definitions.B3: Cerebral Detrimental is to be muddled and wavering. A cogitation that unsettles one's cognitive state intellective clash, madness, a despondent prospect, spiteful reasoning.
definitions.B4: Cerebral Resonance is the force ringing from one's psyche, psychical force. Appearing as the magnetoelectric ripples radiated by the cortex. Indicates the psychical phases alpha, beta, delta, or theta. The measure with which a notion reverberates with the psyche its singular oscillatory imprint.
definitions.B5: Cerebral Womanly is right brain cognition, open disposition, fanciful, generative, the unconscious mind.
definitions.B6: Mental Manly is left brain reasoning, rigid, shut inclined, deductive, and censorious, the waking psyche.
definitions.B7: Mental Cadence is one's cogitation sequence, passage from one ego status to another, how often a singular cogitation arises in one's psyche.
definitions.B8: Cerebral Above is the grasp and reflection of intricate affairs, musing questions of weight, elevated standards, an elevated I.Q., perceptive acumen, sharp, or dazzling intellect.
definitions.B9: Cerebral Below is the inability for grasp. It is rudimentary subjects lowly affairs of base weight and the contemplation of such affairs.
definitions.B10: Cerebral Notion is an idea construed as being wholly of the psyche expressed purely in the mental sphere or purely in the psyche. It is the cerebral aspect of an entity.
definitions.C1: Affective Intellect is apprehension of sentiments, whether one's own or others, when passions steer one's judgments and acts, the faculty to sift through one's sentiments, affective acumen.
definitions.C2: Visceral Favourable is sentiments of gladness, joy, rapture, stillness, and serenity, agreeable passions, ardour, camaraderie.
definitions.C3: Visceral Adverse is affects of anguish, melancholy, wrath, bitterness, disdain, blended passions, solitude, abhorrence, etc.

definitions.C5: Visceral Womanly is compassion, commiseration, absolute approval, carnality, sentiments womanly in nature.
definitions.C6: Affective Manly is hostility, hauteur, commanding, sentiments manly in cast.
definitions.C7: Affective Cadence is temper lurches, the motif or succession of sentiments cast, a visceral rolling sled.
definitions.C8: Affective Above is the affects drawn about by awakening producing one to be above the customary passions felt by the common multitude. definitions.C9: Affective Below is to be engulfed and commanded by channel of sentiments.
definitions.C10: Affective Concept is the husk of a Concept, the metaphoric scent, or atmosphere a Notion bears, like rousing from a reverie and not recalling it but still detecting or sensation its being. It is the affective facet of an object.

F4.length_matching_statement: PER-CODE within +/-5% of the index-matched Arm A definition - half the frozen +/-10% requirement (Section 3.2) - enforced by the deterministic repair pass, and TOKEN-COUNT EXACT: every synonym is a single token, so the number of whitespace tokens and their positions are byte-identical to Arm A for every code and every seed. That is what makes the claim 'clause composition preserved' literally true rather than approximate. RESIDUAL, STATED: synonyms skew long, so F4 still runs a systematic +2.51% longer than Arm A on the arm mean (it is a one-sided, not a symmetric, residual). That offset is small relative to Arm A's own 71..686 char spread, but it is not zero and it points in the direction that makes F4 slightly HARDER to beat on length grounds.
F4.honest_limitation: Coverage is partial. Uncovered content words (proper nouns with no defensible synonym - Akashic, Abba, Amma, Hebrew, alpha/beta/delta/theta, I.Q, 1st - plus any type absent from the frozen lexicon) pass through unchanged, and the length repair reverts further substitutions on the codes where the synonyms ran long or short. The realised per-code and per-seed coverage is published above so that 'F4 destroys unigram identity' can be read as the partial claim it is. A low-coverage code is a WEAK null, i.e. it biases (A - F4) DOWNWARD, which makes the E5 withdrawal rule easier to escape - so this limitation cuts in the direction that favours the canonical arm and must be reported with the E5 result, not buried here.
F4.provenance: ASSISTANT_COMPILED (synonym lexicon + procedure); skeleton is Arm A (OWNER_SOURCE)

F5.name: non_ontological_length_and_register_matched_prose

F5.isolates: whether length and voice alone suffice
F5.gated_by: not directly gated; it is the instrument for the Section 3.3 style residual and is required by P6 (matching tables published)

SPEC_DEVIATION.why: No vetted public-domain corpus exists on this machine (no nltk/gutenberg data; nothing under docs/, api/resources/, or canon/). The two ways to satisfy the frozen wording literally were (a) fetch an external corpus, which this build was not authorised to do, or (b) reproduce public-domain text from memory and label it public-domain, which would be fabricating a provenance claim about a text I cannot verify. Both were refused.
authorship_bias_mitigations: The 40 subjects were fixed as a written list BEFORE any passage was drafted, drawn from concrete craft / infrastructure / natural-science domains.
No passage contains any of the 40 element titles, or the words mind, spirit, soul, emotion, thought, idea, positive, negative, vibration, rhythm, male, female, above, below, cause, effect.
Passage-to-code assignment is driven by authored length target and, per seed, by a length-admissibility permutation - never by any semantic pairing judgement.

S13 (lexical-overlap covariate against the bank glosses) is measured for F5 exactly as for every other arm, so any residual topical affinity is visible in the published covariate rather than asserted absent.
SPEC_DEVIATION.status: REQUIRES A SIGNED AMENDMENT to the pre-registration before capture. It is a substitution of an authored control for a sourced one, and it is disclosed here rather than absorbed silently.

procedure: F5_PROSE is authored ONCE, per code, to the Arm A per-code character target and sentence count.
Per-seed redraw: seed_material = '{DESIGN_ID}|F5|assign|seed={s}'
admissible(passage p -> code c) iff ALL FIVE hold: |len(p)-len(A_c)| <= 0.10*len(A_c); |wps(p)-wps(A_c)| <= 0.15*wps(A_c); |ttr(p)-ttr(A_c)| <= 0.05; |fp(p)-fp(A_c)| <= 0.02; |fk(p)-fk(A_c)| <= 1.5
start from the identity assignment (admissible by authorship), then run 4000 seeded random   transposition proposals, accepting a swap only when BOTH resulting pairings remain admissible
every visited state is admissible, so all five tolerances hold for EVERY seed by construction;
deterministic given the seed. NOT claimed uniform over the admissible set.
F5.per_seed_assignment_note: F5's per-seed variation is a reassignment of a fixed 40-passage pool, not 20 independently authored corpora. Codes whose length band admits only their own passage are FIXED across all 20 seeds. The realised number of moving codes per seed is published in assignment_by_seed; where it is small, F5's text-side seed dispersion is correspondingly small and the seed-to-seed variation in its score comes mostly from the calibration/holdout partition draw, which is itself seeded. This is a weaker form of 'redrawn per seed' than F1/F2/F3/F4 get, and it is stated rather than implied.
F5.assignment_mobility_measured_verdict: MEASURED, and it is small: see assignment_mobility. Requiring all FIVE tolerances (length plus the four style statistics) in the admissibility relation leaves very few legal swaps, so most seeds move 0 or 2 of the 40 codes. The honest reading is that F5 is EFFECTIVELY SEED-INVARIANT ON THE TEXT SIDE. Its seed-to-seed score variation will come almost entirely from the calibration/holdout partition draw, not from a redrawn null. Section 2.6's 'redrawn for each of the 20 registered seeds' is therefore satisfied in form and only weakly in substance for F5 alone. Two honest remedies exist and neither is taken here without an amendment: author 3+ independent 40-passage corpora (real redraw, more assistant-authored text), or relax admissibility to length-only (more mobility, weaker register matching). The trade was resolved in favour of matching quality because F5's job is to answer 'does length and voice alone suffice', which requires the match to hold.

definitions.A1: Coastal survey labour at the harbour commences before the tide has receded, while the mud below the north wall is solid enough to traverse, and the measurements we record then establish the baseline for the week. Every marker post is verified against the brass plate set in the north wall in 1884, and any marker post that has migrated is redriven and recorded in the survey register. The channel migrates a little every winter, so our chart of the deep water is redrawn every spring from the new soundings and from the survey register the pilot boats keep. None of the survey labour is difficult, but the labour is slow, and we cannot hasten the labour if we want the measurements to be worth the reading.
definitions.A2: A sourdough starter is maintained alive by feeding it flour and water on a regular schedule at a constant temperature. Whenever the starter doubles within four hours and smells of apples rather than solvent, the starter will raise a loaf. A neglected starter recovers over three days of regular feeding.
definitions.A3: A canal lock is a basin of water with a gate at each end. The keeper opens the ground paddles and allows the water to rise slowly. Only then is the upper gate swung open. A hurried filling throws the vessel at the sill and can fracture the post.
definitions.A4: The lighthouse lamp revolves upon a bath of mercury, which carries the entire weight of the revolving lens with almost no friction. A clockwork mechanism, wound by hand, maintains the rotation.
definitions.A5: Dry stone walling uses no mortar whatever, only stones selected so that every stone crosses the joint beneath it and settles upon two points rather than upon three points, with the longer axis of every stone running into the wall and a course of heavy stones bedded into the wall at mid height.
definitions.A6: A colony that has become queenless will build emergency cells upon open brood within a day, and the beekeeper who finds those emergency cells decides whether to permit those cells or to unite the colony with a stronger colony. Uniting over newspaper is safer in a colder spring.
definitions.A7: Grafting an apple tree succeeds when a delicate green layer beneath its bark meets the identical layer on the stock.
definitions.A8: Letterpress operation commences at the composing stick, where the type is inverted and the type is read right to left. The forme is seated into the bed with quoins driven against the chase. Ink is applied evenly, since a heavy layer spreads under pressure.
definitions.A9: Signalling upon a single line depends upon the token, a physical staff that only one driver may possess for a particular section. No train enters the section without the token, so two trains cannot occupy the identical section of railway.
definitions.A10: A cheese cellar is held near twelve degrees at high humidity, and the wheels are turned and brushed on a schedule set by the diameter of the wheel and by the rind desired. A young wheel turned too seldom will slump upon one face, and the rind will thicken upon that face. The cellar floor is washed with water alone, since any detergent will alter the flora upon which the rind depends and upon which the cellar depends.
definitions.B1: Glacier monitoring joins yearly stakes with photographic comparison of successive summer surveys. The stakes give a direct measurement of surface loss at set points. The photographs supply the distribution across the entire tongue, including the broken sections that no field party can safely reach.
definitions.B2: Hydroponic nutrient solution needs regular checks on salt content, dissolved oxygen, and the acidity balance within the return line.
definitions.B3: Seismograph calibration compares the recorded response against a reference pendulum of known period. Any drift indicates wear in the magnetic damping assembly.
definitions.B4: Handmade paper depends upon the consistency of the pulp in the vat. The fibres must be dispersed sufficiently to deposit evenly across the face of the mould. Excessive agitation produces turbulence and an irregular sheet. Insufficient agitation permits flocculation and visible clouding.
definitions.B5: Aerial survey mapping needs paired images, accurate camera angles, and surveyed ground control points.
definitions.B6: Standing rigging remains always taut, while running lines are rove freely and hauled when required.
definitions.B7: An escapement releases the train one impulse at a time, turning steady pull from a mainspring into countable oscillation.
definitions.B8: A bridge bearing takes up thermal expansion, rotation under live loading, and the differential settlement of the piers, without passing any restraint into the works below.
definitions.B9: A brick kiln is fired in successive stages. The water smoking stage continues, because water entrapped in the ware vaporises and disintegrates the ware.
definitions.B10: A turbine blade is fabricated as a hollow shell with a spar along the interior length. The hollow shell carries torsional loading and the interior spar carries flexural loading.
definitions.C1: Soil chromatography develops a characteristic radial pattern on treated paper, and the outer edge of the pattern is said to correspond to the microbiological activity within the sample.
definitions.C2: Anodising produces a porous oxide layer, afterwards sealed by hydrothermal treatment or impregnated with organic colourant.
definitions.C3: A vapour cycle circulates one volatile working fluid through evaporation, compression, condensing, and final expansion.
definitions.C4: On a floor loom the warp is threaded through the heddles in the order the pattern requires. A crossed thread becomes a permanent imperfection in the material.
definitions.C5: Plant drug identification uses comparison microscopes, ultraviolet light, paper chromatography, and titration.
definitions.C6: Metal annealing relieves inner stress, restores ductility, and evens grain.
definitions.C7: Estuary sediment drops a coarser fraction near the confluence and the finer material further seaward.
definitions.C8: A terraced vineyard upon a steep slope is worked entirely by hand, because no machinery can turn upon a bench two rows wide and walled downhill with stone. The advantage is that the stone wall accumulates the afternoon heat and returns it to the fruit overnight, so the terraced rows ripen a week before the level ground beneath.
definitions.C9: Quarry drainage is pumped continually whenever the face descends below water.
definitions.C10: Contours on a survey map are interpolated from spot heights along the line of steepest gradient, and the draughtsman closes every contour at the edge of the map or on the contour itself. A contour that stops in open ground is a map error.
definitions.D1: Grinding a telescope mirror proceeds with the mirror blank positioned upon a turntable. The tool is worked across the mirror in relatively shorter strokes. The stroke length governs the curvature, since a longer stroke deepens the centre considerably.
definitions.D2: Reverse osmosis drives pressurised seawater against one fine membrane, producing a stream of drinkable water beside the saltier reject flow of dense brine concentrate.
definitions.D3: Boiler feedwater is treated to remove dissolved oxygen and hardness before it enters the drum. Untreated water deposits scale on the tube walls, which insulates the metal and allows local overheating.
definitions.D4: Emission spectrometry resolves several emitted wavelengths, allowing a direct measure of what elements are present in one heated sample.
definitions.D5: An irrigation channel is graded to a fall of about one in a thousand, steep enough to continue moving and shallow enough to avoid scouring.
definitions.D6: A shorter splice unites the two ropes by tucking the strands against the opposing lay orientation.
definitions.D7: A glaze is fired to a stated cone rather than a given temperature, since cones record total heat work throughout the firing and not one reading.
definitions.D8: Timber is seasoned by stacking the boards in open ranks with strips of the same timber laid between the boards at regular spacing, so that the air moves across every face of every board.
definitions.D9: A net is repaired by trimming the tear back to undamaged mesh upon all four boundaries of the tear, producing a regular diamond, and subsequently refilling the diamond from one corner with a single continuous length of twine.
definitions.D10: Engraving a map plate is executed in reverse, so the engraver operates from a mirrored plate. The map plate lettering is engraved finally.

2.A1: Coastal survey labour at the harbour commences before the tide has receded, while the mud below the north wall is solid enough to traverse, and the measurements we record then establish the baseline for the week. 2.A2: A sourdough starter is maintained alive by feeding it flour and water on a regular schedule at a constant temperature. Whenever the starter doubles within four hours and smells of apples rather than solvent, the starter will raise a loaf. A neglected starter recovers over three days of regular feeding.
2.A3: A canal lock is a basin of water with a gate at each end. The keeper opens the ground paddles and allows the water to rise slowly. Only then is the upper gate swung open. A hurried filling throws the vessel at the sill and can fracture the post.
2.A4: The lighthouse lamp revolves upon a bath of mercury, which carries the entire weight of the revolving lens with almost no friction. A clockwork mechanism, wound by hand, maintains the rotation.
2.A5: Dry stone walling uses no mortar whatever, only stones selected so that every stone crosses the joint beneath it and settles upon two points rather than upon three points, with the longer axis of every stone running into the wall and a course of heavy stones bedded into the wall at mid height.
2.A6: A colony that has become queenless will build emergency cells upon open brood within a day, and the beekeeper who finds those emergency cells decides whether to permit those cells or to unite the colony with a stronger colony. Uniting over newspaper is safer in a colder spring.
2.A7: Grafting an apple tree succeeds when a delicate green layer beneath its bark meets the identical layer on the stock.
2.A8: Letterpress operation commences at the composing stick, where the type is inverted and the type is read right to left. The forme is seated into the bed with quoins driven against the chase. Ink is applied evenly, since a heavy layer spreads under pressure.
2.A9: Signalling upon a single line depends upon the token, a physical staff that only one driver may possess for a particular section. No train enters the section without the token, so two trains cannot occupy the identical section of railway.
2.A10: A cheese cellar is held near twelve degrees at high humidity, and the wheels are turned and brushed on a schedule set by the diameter of the wheel and by the rind desired. A young wheel turned too seldom will slump upon one face, and the rind will thicken upon that face. The cellar floor is washed with water alone, since any detergent will alter the flora upon which the rind depends and upon which the cellar depends.
2.B1: Glacier monitoring joins yearly stakes with photographic comparison of successive summer surveys. The stakes give a direct measurement of surface loss at set points. 2.B10: A turbine blade is fabricated as a hollow shell with a spar along the interior length. The hollow shell carries torsional loading and the interior spar carries flexural loading.
2.C1: Soil chromatography develops a characteristic radial pattern on treated paper, and the outer edge of the pattern is said to correspond to the microbiological activity within the sample.
2.C2: Anodising produces a porous oxide layer, afterwards sealed by hydrothermal treatment or impregnated with organic colourant.
2.C3: A vapour cycle circulates one volatile working fluid through evaporation, compression, condensing, and final expansion.
2.C4: On a floor loom the warp is threaded through the heddles in the order the pattern requires. A crossed thread becomes a permanent imperfection in the material.
2.C5: Plant drug identification uses comparison microscopes, ultraviolet light, paper chromatography, and titration.
2.C6: Metal annealing relieves inner stress, restores ductility, and evens grain.
2.C7: Estuary sediment drops a coarser fraction near the confluence and the finer material further seaward.

2.D4: Emission spectrometry resolves several emitted wavelengths, allowing a direct measure of what elements are present in one heated sample.

19.A10: A cheese cellar is held near twelve degrees at high humidity, and the wheels are turned and brushed on a schedule set by the diameter of the wheel and by the rind desired. A young wheel turned too seldom will slump upon one face, and the rind will thicken upon that face. The cellar floor is washed with water alone, since any detergent will alter the flora upon which the rind depends and upon which the cellar depends.
19.B1: Glacier monitoring joins yearly stakes with photographic comparison of successive summer surveys. The stakes give a direct measurement of surface loss at set points. The photographs supply the distribution across the entire tongue, including the broken sections that no field party can safely reach.
19.B2: Hydroponic nutrient solution needs regular checks on salt content, dissolved oxygen, and the acidity balance within the return line.
19.B3: Seismograph calibration compares the recorded response against a reference pendulum of known period. Any drift indicates wear in the magnetic damping assembly.
19.B4: Handmade paper depends upon the consistency of the pulp in the vat. The fibres must be dispersed sufficiently to deposit evenly across the face of the mould. Excessive agitation produces turbulence and an irregular sheet. Insufficient agitation permits flocculation and visible clouding.
19.B5: Aerial survey mapping needs paired images, accurate camera angles, and surveyed ground control points.
19.B6: Standing rigging remains always taut, while running lines are rove freely and hauled when required.
19.B7: An escapement releases the train one impulse at a time, turning steady pull from a mainspring into countable oscillation.
19.B8: Reverse osmosis drives pressurised seawater against one fine membrane, producing a stream of drinkable water beside the saltier reject flow of dense brine concentrate.
19.B9: A brick kiln is fired in successive stages. The water smoking stage continues, because water entrapped in the ware vaporises and disintegrates the ware.
19.B10: A turbine blade is fabricated as a hollow shell with a spar along the interior length. The hollow shell carries torsional loading and the interior spar carries flexural loading.
19.C1: Soil chromatography develops a characteristic radial pattern on treated paper, and the outer edge of the pattern is said to correspond to the microbiological activity within the sample.
19.C2: Anodising produces a porous oxide layer, afterwards sealed by hydrothermal treatment or impregnated with organic colourant.
19.C3: A vapour cycle circulates one volatile working fluid through evaporation, compression, condensing, and final expansion.
19.C4: On a floor loom the warp is threaded through the heddles in the order the pattern requires. A crossed thread becomes a permanent imperfection in the material.
19.C5: Plant drug identification uses comparison microscopes, ultraviolet light, paper chromatography, and titration.
19.C6: Metal annealing relieves inner stress, restores ductility, and evens grain.
19.C7: Estuary sediment drops a coarser fraction near the confluence and the finer material further seaward.
19.C8: A terraced vineyard upon a steep slope is worked entirely by hand, because no machinery can turn upon a bench two rows wide and walled downhill with stone. The advantage is that the stone wall accumulates the afternoon heat and returns it to the fruit overnight, so the terraced rows ripen a week before the level ground beneath.
19.C9: Quarry drainage is pumped continually whenever the face descends below water.
19.C10: Contours on a survey map are interpolated from spot heights along the line of steepest gradient, and the draughtsman closes every contour at the edge of the map or on the contour itself. A contour that stops in open ground is a map error.
19.D1: Grinding a telescope mirror proceeds with the mirror blank positioned upon a turntable. The tool is worked across the mirror in relatively shorter strokes. The stroke length governs the curvature, since a longer stroke deepens the centre considerably.
19.D2: A bridge bearing takes up thermal expansion, rotation under live loading, and the differential settlement of the piers, without passing any restraint into the works below.
19.D3: Boiler feedwater is treated to remove dissolved oxygen and hardness before it enters the drum. Untreated water deposits scale on the tube walls, which insulates the metal and allows local overheating.
19.D4: Emission spectrometry resolves several emitted wavelengths, allowing a direct measure of what elements are present in one heated sample.
19.D5: An irrigation channel is graded to a fall of about one in a thousand, steep enough to continue moving and shallow enough to avoid scouring.
19.D6: A shorter splice unites the two ropes by tucking the strands against the opposing lay orientation.
19.D7: A glaze is fired to a stated cone rather than a given temperature, since cones record total heat work throughout the firing and not one reading.
19.D8: Timber is seasoned by stacking the boards in open ranks with strips of the same timber laid between the boards at regular spacing, so that the air moves across every face of every board.
19.D9: A net is repaired by trimming the tear back to undamaged mesh upon all four boundaries of the tear, producing a regular diamond, and subsequently refilling the diamond from one corner with a single continuous length of twine.
19.D10: Engraving a map plate is executed in reverse, so the engraver operates from a mirrored plate. The map plate lettering is engraved finally.

prose_pool_authored.A1: Coastal survey labour at the harbour commences before the tide has receded, while the mud below the north wall is solid enough to traverse, and the measurements we record then establish the baseline for the week. Every marker post is verified against the brass plate set in the north wall in 1884, and any marker post that has migrated is redriven and recorded in the survey register. The channel migrates a little every winter, so our chart of the deep water is redrawn every spring from the new soundings and from the survey register the pilot boats keep. None of the survey labour is difficult, but the labour is slow, and we cannot hasten the labour if we want the measurements to be worth the reading.
prose_pool_authored.A2: A sourdough starter is maintained alive by feeding it flour and water on a regular schedule at a constant temperature. Whenever the starter doubles within four hours and smells of apples rather than solvent, the starter will raise a loaf. A neglected starter recovers over three days of regular feeding.
prose_pool_authored.A3: A canal lock is a basin of water with a gate at each end. The keeper opens the ground paddles and allows the water to rise slowly. Only then is the upper gate swung open. A hurried filling throws the vessel at the sill and can fracture the post.

prose_pool_authored.A5: Dry stone walling uses no mortar whatever, only stones selected so that every stone crosses the joint beneath it and settles upon two points rather than upon three points, with the longer axis of every stone running into the wall and a course of heavy stones bedded into the wall at mid height.
prose_pool_authored.A6: A colony that has become queenless will build emergency cells upon open brood within a day, and the beekeeper who finds those emergency cells decides whether to permit those cells or to unite the colony with a stronger colony. definitions.A1: Phylogenetic Benevolence is the lineage history of care for associates, the comparative record of helping, grooming, food sharing, and provisioning in related species, and the ancestral form it was built upon.
definitions.A2: Mechanistic Tradition is the near machinery of custom. It comprises copying and the cues that set off a rite. It takes in as well the stores that hold a handed-down practice and retrieve it on the days a culture marks out for it.
definitions.A3: Phylogenetic Tradition is the past of handed-on custom, the record of which kindred taxa carry local practices, and of how deeply in time that shared capacity can be traced back.
definitions.A4: Phylogenetic Conformity is restraint's lineage history, the comparative record of impulse-inhibition in taxa that live in groups with enforced, policed expectations.
definitions.A5: Phylogenetic Achievement is the lineage past of shown skill, its ties to similar traits in kindred taxa, its rise, and its re-use in later lines.
definitions.A6: Mechanistic Power is the near apparatus of status seeking and of control over persons and resources, comprising posture, voice, hormonal swing, the attention paid to rank cues, and the reading of who won a contest, all of which tell how dominance and deference are made inside one encounter.
definitions.A7: Functional Conformity is the payoff of restraint, the collective cost avoided when a member holds back.
definitions.A8: Functional Universalism is the use of care that reaches well past the near circle. It is the gain in keeping a shared home, a far-off ally, an unrelated stranger, and a claimant not yet born in good standing.
definitions.A9: Developmental Power is the ontogeny of rank, precedence, and the juvenile climb toward standing.
definitions.A10: Functional Power is the payoff of rank, the access priority that status confers over contested resources.
definitions.B1: Developmental Security is the ontogeny of safety, how early attachment sets a later tolerance for risk.
definitions.B2: Developmental Benevolence is the ontogeny of care. It runs from contagious infant distress through toddler helping to the reasoned loyalty of an adult.
definitions.B3: Developmental Conformity is the ontogeny of restraint, the growth of impulse control and the learning of which expectations a group enforces.
definitions.B4: Developmental Tradition is the ontogeny of inherited custom in one individual, the course of taking up a practice by watching elders and rehearsing it until it is habitual.
definitions.B5: Phylogenetic Hedonism is the lineage history of pleasure. It is the deep conservation of reward machinery across distant animal groups, and the later divergence of what each separate group finds gratifying.
definitions.B6: Mechanistic Hedonism is the working apparatus of pleasure and of the senses as it runs in real time. It asks what a receptor takes up. It asks how strong a thing feels. Those answers tell how the pleasure is made, how long it holds, and how fast it fades.
definitions.B7: Developmental Universalism is the ontogeny of wide concern. It is the widening of the circle a person will count as owed something, out from kin to group to stranger.
definitions.B8: Mechanistic Stimulation is the here-and-now apparatus that propels the search for novelty, thrill, and challenge. How high the bar for arousal sits, how sharply a surprise is met, and how fast a repeated event stops being felt are its parts. Together they tell how a nervous system turns the strange into approach.
definitions.B9: Phylogenetic Power is the past of rank: pecking orders, precedence, deference, threat, appeasement, and their reach across many clades.
definitions.B10: Phylogenetic Self-Direction is the lineage history of autonomous choosing. It is the comparative record of where independent action turns up across related species. It asks how often that was gained or lost, and what it was built upon.
definitions.C1: Phylogenetic Security is the past of defence: old, deep, kept, shared, and built on by all later lines.
definitions.C2: Mechanistic Security is the working threat-detection and steadying apparatus of an actor. It is made up of vigilance, startle, defensive reflex, and the appraisal that marks a setting as safe or unsafe and then holds conduct steady until that marking is revised.
definitions.C3: Functional Tradition is inherited custom's survival value, the advantage of carrying a solution already field-tested by earlier generations instead of re-deriving it from nothing. A practice persisting without ever being understood can still be adaptive, because the population, and not the individual, paid for every error.
definitions.C4: Functional Security is caution's survival value, plus stability under threat.
definitions.C5: Phylogenetic Stimulation is the lineage history of novelty seeking, traced by comparing how related species explore and by reconstructing their common ancestral form.
definitions.C6: Developmental Self-Direction is the ontogeny of autonomous choosing across a whole lifetime. Undirected infant activity becomes juvenile exploration, and then contested adolescent independence. At last there comes a settled adult capacity to originate a goal unprompted.
definitions.C7: Functional Self-Direction is the survival value of independent choosing, the advantage of acting on self-gathered information when copying a neighbour would mislead, delay, or misfire.
definitions.C8: Functional Stimulation is the use of novelty: news, range, luck, reach, spread, and a way out when the old way fails.
definitions.C9: Functional Hedonism is the fitness role of pleasure: reinforcement, preference, appetite, consummation, and renewed pursuit.
definitions.C10: Phylogenetic Universalism is the lineage history of wide concern. It is the rarest of these, and the most recently derived of them.
definitions.D1: Mechanistic Benevolence is the immediate apparatus of care aimed at close associates. It is made up of affiliative signalling, the reading of distress, grooming, and the appraisal that sends help toward a known rather than an unknown recipient.
definitions.D2: Mechanistic Conformity is the restraint-apparatus inhibiting an impulse likely to upset onlookers or breach an expectation.
definitions.D3: Functional Benevolence is the payoff of caring for close associates.
definitions.D4: Developmental Hedonism is the ontogeny of the pleasure repertoire. An early preference for sweetness and warmth becomes the acquired tastes of one whole life.
definitions.D5: Mechanistic Universalism is the working apparatus of concern reaching past the familiar circle, out to strangers, to other kinds, and to the habitat all of them share. It is made up of taking the view of another, of pushing out the edge of a category on purpose, and of holding a picture of some far-off party who will never be met. Mechanism asks only what makes wide concern run at the moment it runs.
definitions.D6: Mechanistic Achievement is the live system that shows skill against a bar. It is made of paced effort, caught slips, taken cues, kept aims, and word on how the try went.
definitions.D7: Developmental Achievement is the ontogeny of shown skill. First come the mastery tries of a babe in arms. Then comes graded task load in the years of play. At last set bars, rivals, and one's own eye on the self make the grown pattern of striving toward a mark a watcher can score.
definitions.D8: Functional Achievement is the use of shown skill. A clear record of it earns mates, tools, aid, rank, trust, and a better share of the work.
definitions.D9: Mechanistic Self-Direction is the near cause of a free choice, the working parts that let an actor choose, create, and explore at the moment it acts. It covers what the senses take in, the state of the body, the wiring that carries it, and the loops that make going one's own way the option taken rather than falling in with the rest. To ask after mechanism is to ask what goes on inside the actor and just around it right now, never why the trait is there at all. A signal of curiosity, a guess at a reward, a hold placed on a cued response, and the power to keep a goal of one's own against a pull the other way are each answers of this kind, and each can be measured and moved.
definitions.D10: Developmental Stimulation is the ontogeny of novelty seeking, from infant orienting through juvenile play to the calibrated risk taking of maturity.

1.B3: Phylogenetic Power is the past of rank: pecking orders, precedence, deference, threat, appeasement, and their reach across many clades.
1.B4: Developmental Tradition is the ontogeny of inherited custom in one individual, the course of taking up a practice by watching elders and rehearsing it until it is habitual.
1.B5: Functional Stimulation is the use of novelty: news, range, luck, reach, spread, and a way out when the old way fails.
1.B6: Phylogenetic Tradition is the past of handed-on custom, the record of which kindred taxa carry local practices, and of how deeply in time that shared capacity can be traced back.
1.B7: Mechanistic Power is the near apparatus of status seeking and of control over persons and resources, comprising posture, voice, hormonal swing, the attention paid to rank cues, and the reading of who won a contest, all of which tell how dominance and deference are made inside one encounter.
1.B8: Functional Conformity is the payoff of restraint, the collective cost avoided when a member holds back.
1.B9: Mechanistic Benevolence is the immediate apparatus of care aimed at close associates. It is made up of affiliative signalling, the reading of distress, grooming, and the appraisal that sends help toward a known rather than an unknown recipient.
1.B10: Functional Universalism is the use of care that reaches well past the near circle. It is the gain in keeping a shared home, a far-off ally, an unrelated stranger, and a claimant not yet born in good standing.
1.C1: Mechanistic Tradition is the near machinery of custom. It comprises copying and the cues that set off a rite. It takes in as well the stores that hold a handed-down practice and retrieve it on the days a culture marks out for it.
1.C2: Phylogenetic Achievement is the lineage past of shown skill, its ties to similar traits in kindred taxa, its rise, and its re-use in later lines.
1.C3: Mechanistic Stimulation is the here-and-now apparatus that propels the search for novelty, thrill, and challenge. How high the bar for arousal sits, how sharply a surprise is met, and how fast a repeated event stops being felt are its parts. Together they tell how a nervous system turns the strange into approach.
1.C4: Mechanistic Self-Direction is the near cause of a free choice, the working parts that let an actor choose, create, and explore at the moment it acts. It covers what the senses take in, the state of the body, the wiring that carries it, and the loops that make going one's own way the option taken rather than falling in with the rest. To ask after mechanism is to ask what goes on inside the actor and just around it right now, never why the trait is there at all. A signal of curiosity, a guess at a reward, a hold placed on a cued response, and the power to keep a goal of one's own against a pull the other way are each answers of this kind, and each can be measured and moved.
1.C5: Phylogenetic Security is the past of defence: old, deep, kept, shared, and built on by all later lines.
1.C6: Functional Achievement is the use of shown skill. A clear record of it earns mates, tools, aid, rank, trust, and a better share of the work.
1.C7: Developmental Power is the ontogeny of rank, precedence, and the juvenile climb toward standing.
1.C8: Developmental Security is the ontogeny of safety, how early attachment sets a later tolerance for risk.
1.C9: Mechanistic Hedonism is the working apparatus of pleasure and of the senses as it runs in real time. It asks what a receptor takes up. It asks how strong a thing feels. Those answers tell how the pleasure is made, how long it holds, and how fast it fades.
1.C10: Functional Self-Direction is the survival value of independent choosing, the advantage of acting on self-gathered information when copying a neighbour would mislead, delay, or misfire.
1.D1: Mechanistic Security is the working threat-detection and steadying apparatus of an actor. It is made up of vigilance, startle, defensive reflex, and the appraisal that marks a setting as safe or unsafe and then holds conduct steady until that marking is revised.
1.D2: Functional Security is caution's survival value, plus stability under threat.
1.D3: Developmental Achievement is the ontogeny of shown skill. First come the mastery tries of a babe in arms. Then comes graded task load in the years of play. At last set bars, rivals, and one's own eye on the self make the grown pattern of striving toward a mark a watcher can score.
1.D4: Functional Hedonism is the fitness role of pleasure: reinforcement, preference, appetite, consummation, and renewed pursuit.
1.D5: Phylogenetic Self-Direction is the lineage history of autonomous choosing. It is the comparative record of where independent action turns up across related species. It asks how often that was gained or lost, and what it was built upon.
1.D6: Phylogenetic Conformity is restraint's lineage history, the comparative record of impulse-inhibition in taxa that live in groups with enforced, policed expectations.
1.D7: Phylogenetic Hedonism is the lineage history of pleasure. It is the deep conservation of reward machinery across distant animal groups, and the later divergence of what each separate group finds gratifying.
1.D8: Developmental Conformity is the ontogeny of restraint, the growth of impulse control and the learning of which expectations a group enforces.
1.D9: Mechanistic Universalism is the working apparatus of concern reaching past the familiar circle, out to strangers, to other kinds, and to the habitat all of them share. It is made up of taking the view of another, of pushing out the edge of a category on purpose, and of holding a picture of some far-off party who will never be met. Mechanism asks only what makes wide concern run at the moment it runs.
1.D10: Developmental Self-Direction is the ontogeny of autonomous choosing across a whole lifetime. Undirected infant activity becomes juvenile exploration, and then contested adolescent independence. At last there comes a settled adult capacity to originate a goal unprompted.

18.A1: Phylogenetic Hedonism is the lineage history of pleasure. It is the deep conservation of reward machinery across distant animal groups, and the later divergence of what each separate group finds gratifying.
18.A2: Developmental Conformity is the ontogeny of restraint, the growth of impulse control and the learning of which expectations a group enforces.
18.A3: Functional Power is the payoff of rank, the access priority that status confers over contested resources.
18.A4: Mechanistic Tradition is the near machinery of custom. It comprises copying and the cues that set off a rite. It takes in as well the stores that hold a handed-down practice and retrieve it on the days a culture marks out for it.
18.A5: Mechanistic Hedonism is the working apparatus of pleasure and of the senses as it runs in real time. It asks what a receptor takes up. It asks how strong a thing feels. Those answers tell how the pleasure is made, how long it holds, and how fast it fades.
18.A6: Mechanistic Universalism is the working apparatus of concern reaching past the familiar circle, out to strangers, to other kinds, and to the habitat all of them share. It is made up of taking the view of another, of pushing out the edge of a category on purpose, and of holding a picture of some far-off party who will never be met. Mechanism asks only what makes wide concern run at the moment it runs.
18.A7: Phylogenetic Achievement is the lineage past of shown skill, its ties to similar traits in kindred taxa, its rise, and its re-use in later lines.
18.A8: Developmental Self-Direction is the ontogeny of autonomous choosing across a whole lifetime. Undirected infant activity becomes juvenile exploration, and then contested adolescent independence. At last there comes a settled adult capacity to originate a goal unprompted.
18.A9: Functional Self-Direction is the survival value of independent choosing, the advantage of acting on self-gathered information when copying a neighbour would mislead, delay, or misfire.
18.A10: Developmental Power is the ontogeny of rank, precedence, and the juvenile climb toward standing.
18.B1: Functional Universalism is the use of care that reaches well past the near circle. It is the gain in keeping a shared home, a far-off ally, an unrelated stranger, and a claimant not yet born in good standing.
18.B2: Mechanistic Conformity is the restraint-apparatus inhibiting an impulse likely to upset onlookers or breach an expectation.
18.B3: Developmental Stimulation is the ontogeny of novelty seeking, from infant orienting through juvenile play to the calibrated risk taking of maturity.
18.B4: Functional Stimulation is the use of novelty: news, range, luck, reach, spread, and a way out when the old way fails.
18.B5: Developmental Tradition is the ontogeny of inherited custom in one individual, the course of taking up a practice by watching elders and rehearsing it until it is habitual.
18.B6: Mechanistic Achievement is the live system that shows skill against a bar. It is made of paced effort, caught slips, taken cues, kept aims, and word on how the try went.
18.B7: Mechanistic Power is the near apparatus of status seeking and of control over persons and resources, comprising posture, voice, hormonal swing, the attention paid to rank cues, and the reading of who won a contest, all of which tell how dominance and deference are made inside one encounter.
18.B8: Developmental Universalism is the ontogeny of wide concern. It is the widening of the circle a person will count as owed something, out from kin to group to stranger.
18.B9: Functional Tradition is inherited custom's survival value, the advantage of carrying a solution already field-tested by earlier generations instead of re-deriving it from nothing. A practice persisting without ever being understood can still be adaptive, because the population, and not the individual, paid for every error.
18.B10: Phylogenetic Benevolence is the lineage history of care for associates, the comparative record of helping, grooming, food sharing, and provisioning in related species, and the ancestral form it was built upon.
18.C1: Developmental Security is the ontogeny of safety, how early attachment sets a later tolerance for risk.
18.C2: Phylogenetic Power is the past of rank: pecking orders, precedence, deference, threat, appeasement, and their reach across many clades.
18.C3: Phylogenetic Self-Direction is the lineage history of autonomous choosing. It is the comparative record of where independent action turns up across related species. It asks how often that was gained or lost, and what it was built upon.
18.C4: Functional Security is caution's survival value, plus stability under threat.
18.C5: Mechanistic Benevolence is the immediate apparatus of care aimed at close associates. It is made up of affiliative signalling, the reading of distress, grooming, and the appraisal that sends help toward a known rather than an unknown recipient.
18.C6: Phylogenetic Security is the past of defence: old, deep, kept, shared, and built on by all later lines.
18.C7: Phylogenetic Universalism is the lineage history of wide concern. It is the rarest of these, and the most recently derived of them.
18.C8: Phylogenetic Conformity is restraint's lineage history, the comparative record of impulse-inhibition in taxa that live in groups with enforced, policed expectations.
18.C9: Developmental Achievement is the ontogeny of shown skill. First come the mastery tries of a babe in arms. Then comes graded task load in the years of play. At last set bars, rivals, and one's own eye on the self make the grown pattern of striving toward a mark a watcher can score.
18.C10: Developmental Benevolence is the ontogeny of care. It runs from contagious infant distress through toddler helping to the reasoned loyalty of an adult.
18.D1: Phylogenetic Stimulation is the lineage history of novelty seeking, traced by comparing how related species explore and by reconstructing their common ancestral form.
18.D2: Functional Hedonism is the fitness role of pleasure: reinforcement, preference, appetite, consummation, and renewed pursuit.
18.D3: Mechanistic Security is the working threat-detection and steadying apparatus of an actor. It is made up of vigilance, startle, defensive reflex, and the appraisal that marks a setting as safe or unsafe and then holds conduct steady until that marking is revised.
18.D4: Functional Conformity is the payoff of restraint, the collective cost avoided when a member holds back.
18.D5: Phylogenetic Tradition is the past of handed-on custom, the record of which kindred taxa carry local practices, and of how deeply in time that shared capacity can be traced back.
18.D6: Developmental Hedonism is the ontogeny of the pleasure repertoire. An early preference for sweetness and warmth becomes the acquired tastes of one whole life.
18.D7: Functional Achievement is the use of shown skill. A clear record of it earns mates, tools, aid, rank, trust, and a better share of the work.
18.D8: Functional Benevolence is the payoff of caring for close associates.
18.D9: Mechanistic Stimulation is the here-and-now apparatus that propels the search for novelty, thrill, and challenge. How high the bar for arousal sits, how sharply a surprise is met, and how fast a repeated event stops being felt are its parts. Together they tell how a nervous system turns the strange into approach.
18.D10: Mechanistic Self-Direction is the near cause of a free choice, the working parts that let an actor choose, create, and explore at the moment it acts. It covers what the senses take in, the state of the body, the wiring that carries it, and the loops that make going one's own way the option taken rather than falling in with the rest. To ask after mechanism is to ask what goes on inside the actor and just around it right now, never why the trait is there at all. A signal of curiosity, a guess at a reward, a hold placed on a cued response, and the power to keep a goal of one's own against a pull the other way are each answers of this kind, and each can be measured and moved.

F6.length_matching_statement: INHERITED FROM ARM E, DISTRIBUTION-EXACT, NOT PER-CODE - the same structure as F1. Arm E is itself per-code matched to Arm A within +/-10% (Section 2.5), so F6's length MULTISET is within +/-10% of Arm A's at every order statistic; but the derangement moves each passage to a different code, so the per-code delta is non-zero and is bounded by the spread of Arm A's own length distribution (71..686 chars). Published per code once Arm E exists.
F6.provenance: ASSISTANT_COMPILED (derangement); text will be ASSISTANT_AUTHORED_FROM_EXTERNAL_ONTOLOGIES via Arm E

prereg_conformance.family_semantics_differ_from_the_task_br: The task brief proposed F3 = lexical-matched gibberish, F4 = unrelated-domain text, F5 = empty/minimal floor, F6 = random-direction. The LOCKED pre-registration (Section 2.6) assigns F3 = random-direction anchors, F4 = synonym-substituted Arm A, F5 = non-ontological length-and-register-matched prose, F6 = Arm E deranged onto TKS codes. THE FROZEN SPEC WAS FOLLOWED. The brief's ideas map onto the frozen families as: label-shuffled -> F1 (identical), word-shuffled -> F2 (identical), lexical-matched -> F4 (synonyms rather than gibberish, because gibberish is not 'matched in style, not degenerate'), unrelated-domain -> F5 (identical in spirit), random-direction -> F3 (identical, renumbered).
prereg_conformance.no_empty_or_minimal_family_exists: The brief asked for an empty/minimal floor control. The pre-registration contains none, and Section 9.3 forbids adding an axis post hoc. It was NOT added. The design's floor reference is S1 (majority class, chance = 0.0250) together with F3, whose expected score is chance - so the floor the brief wanted is already covered by two pre-registered controls, neither of which is a degenerate string.

honest_limitations: F1 and F6 are distribution-matched but NOT per-code length-matched. That is forced by the frozen 'unconstrained derangement' construction; a length-constrained derangement would be a different, unregistered control. The per-code delta tables are published so the residual is auditable.
F3 is a specification, not numbers. The hidden dimension d depends on the model at required_run_bindings[8], which is unavailable_until_capture_host_resolved (B8). No vectors were fabricated.

F6 resolved against the Arm E payload present at build time; its text is only as good as Arm E, which is itself assistant-authored and has not yet passed the Section 2.5 blind straw-man audit (precondition P6). If Arm E is rewritten after that audit, F6 MUST be rebuilt - the derangements are stable, the text is not.

F4's synonym coverage is partial (published per code and per seed). Partial coverage makes F4 a WEAKER null, which biases (A - F4) downward and therefore makes the E5 withdrawal rule easier to escape. It favours the canonical arm and must be reported alongside E5.

F5 deviates from the frozen 'public-domain' wording: it is assistant-authored. This needs a signed amendment before capture. Assistant authorship of a control is exactly the provenance discount Section 11.2 finding 6 warns about.

F5's per-seed redraw is a reassignment within a fixed pool, not 20 independent corpora, and the measured mobility is 0 or 2 of 40 codes per seed - F5 is effectively seed-invariant on the text side. See families.F5.assignment_mobility_measured_verdict.
